title: One operation for a high-reading cohort

slides.caption: Button held
slides.action: Send mouseDown to the center of the mounted button.
slides.expected: Pressed control and empty cohort before release.

slides.caption: Mouse selection
slides.action: Release, then click the replacement button.
slides.expected: Both IDs produce the same cohort of observations 104 and 318.

slides.caption: Keyboard selection
slides.action: Start fresh and send F2 to the canvas.
slides.expected: Keyboard status and the same two members without a click.

slides.caption: Script selection
slides.action: Invoke the trusted script adapter on a fresh notebook.
slides.expected: Script status and the same two stable IDs.

slides.caption: Read-only caller
slides.action: Submit the operation on the populated notebook as an agent.
slides.expected: Rejection leaves cohort membership and write count intact.
